in_hebrew.name: Alathia
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Alathia הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'aletheia', meaning 'truth' or 'sincerity'. In ancient Greek culture, Aletheia was the goddess of truth and revelation. In a Christian context, the name Alathia represents a commitment to honesty, transparency, and authenticity.
